text: sampassamāno tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ chasu phassāyatanesu appamādena karaṇīyanti vadāmīti .pe. santi bhikkhave manoviññeyyā dhammā manoramāpi amanoramāpi tyāssa phussa phussa cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhanti cetaso apariyādānā āraddhaṃ hoti viriyaṃ asallīnaṃ upaṭṭhitā sati appamuṭṭhā passaddho kāyo asāraddho samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ekaggaṃ . imaṃ khvāhaṃ bhikkhave appamādaphalaṃ sampassamāno tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ chasu phassāyatanesu appamādena karaṇīyanti vadāmīti . paṭhamaṃ . [214] lābhā vo bhikkhave suladdhaṃ vo bhikkhave khaṇo vo bhikkhave paṭiladdho brahmacariyavāsāya . diṭṭhā mayā
